instrument: Prakriti Parikshan (Vata / Pitta / Kapha), 40-item Govardhan School of Yoga workbook
note: Percentages are each dosha's points out of 80 (see prakriti.json scoring_notes: 2 pts per single tick, 1 pt each for a double tick), so they always sum to 100. Classification follows the Govardhan workbook order, first match wins: Sama -> Ekadoshaja -> Dvandvaja. Results within boundary_window points of a rule threshold are flagged near_boundary and should be read against both candidate profiles, as the workbook asks. The Vikriti check (prakriti.json vikriti_check) is read alongside this result but scored and stored separately, never merged into these percentages.

VAT.label: Vata
VAT.description: Light, quick, variable. When strong: creative, quick-thinking, adaptable, but prone to restlessness, irregular routines, and anxiety under stress.

PIT.label: Pitta
PIT.description: Sharp, warm, intense. When strong: focused, driven, decisive, but prone to irritability, impatience, and burning out under pressure.

KAP.label: Kapha
KAP.description: Heavy, steady, slow. When strong: calm, grounded, loyal, but prone to inertia, resistance to change, and low motivation to start things.

dominance_patterns.label: Sama (Tridoshaja)
dominance_patterns.description: Rare — no single dosha leads. The workbook asks to re-check before accepting; likely to feel different from day to day depending on season, sleep, and stress.

dominance_patterns.condition: highest dosha leads the second by >= 15 points
dominance_patterns.label: {dosha}-dominant
dominance_patterns.description: A clear single constitutional tendency (Ekadoshaja); the described traits and imbalance-patterns for that dosha apply fairly directly.

dominance_patterns.label: {dosha_a}-{dosha_b} (dual)
dominance_patterns.description: The most common pattern (Dvandvaja) — traits from both doshas show up, often in different contexts (e.g. one under stress, the other at rest). The higher dosha is named first.
